listing.summary: Upstream reports 145 translated functions and comparisons covering 20,000 frames. Random-number behavior, music and audio alignment differ; completion is unconfirmed. Portcove has not confirmed runtime behavior or gameplay. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Russian Felix the Cat Unl Genesis ROM: 1 MiB, CRC32 BF9BA3BC. Keep your original separately.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build locally for x64 with Visual Studio 2019 and CMake. Supply felix.bin and run FelixTheCatRecomp.exe following upstream instructions. Portcove does not install or build this project automatically.
